endorsements.name: Morgan ``indrora'' Gangwere
endorsements.label: It's Assembler, Jim, but not as we know it: (ab)using binaries from embedded devices for fun and profit
endorsements.description: With the proliferation of Linux-based SoCs -- you've likely got one or two in your house, on your person or in your pocket -- it is often useful to look "under the hood" at what is running; Additionally, in-situ debugging may be unavailable due to read-only filesystems, memory is often limited, and other factors keep us from attacking a live device. This talk looks at attacking binaries outside their native environment using QEMU, the Quick Emulator, as well as techniques for extracting relevant content from devices and exploring them.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 26
